{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 专家编排模式 agent preset — PM-first planning, Agency expert delegation, gated delivery, experience pooling","id":"gh:1365355680","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-expert-orchestrator","slug":"mario841859784/dsh-expert-orchestrator","topics":["agent-preset","ai-agents","coding-agent","cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","multi-agent","orchestration","plugin","subagent","task-delegation"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 专家编排模式 agent preset — PM-first planning, Agency expert delegation, gated delivery, experience po"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"家编排模式 agent preset — PM-first planning, Agency expert delegation, gated delivery, experience pooling"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Expert Orchestrator"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Multi-agent orchestration · PM-first planning · merged-roster expert delegation · dependency-DAG t"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"askboard · gated delivery · experience pooling**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **agent preset plugin**: once installed, DSH gets an "Expert Orchestrator" "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"session mode that never implements changes itself — it triages every request, has a project-manageme"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"nt expert plan the work, delegates implementation to the best-fit domain experts, and gates delivery"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" with independent review."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What our evaluation shows"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Before the technical details, here is what this plugin can and cannot do — measured, not promised. W"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e ran a head-to-head comparison on 2026-10-19 (this plugin v2.9.8 on host dsh 0.2.1-rc.2): the same "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"18 task scenarios were attempted 3 times with the plugin on and 3 times with it off — **108 tasks in"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" total, all driven by one model (glm-5.3-flash), at a total cost of about $11.55**."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**In plain words:**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Easy tasks: both setups get them right.** Turning the plugin on or off makes no difference on si"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"mple tasks.
- **Harder tasks: the orchestrated version is a bit steadier** — and each successfully s"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"olved task also cost slightly less with it ($0.0766 vs $0.0887 per solved task). Treat the cost diff"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"erence as a hint, not proof: statistically it is not significant.
- **Honest expectation: overall ac"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"curacy went up by 6.7 percentage points (86.7% → 93.3%** on the 15 gradeable scenarios**)**. That is"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" a real improvement in this run — but it did **not** reach the +20pp "significant improvement" bar w"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"e committed to before the experiment, and the confidence interval's lower bound is 0. So we **cannot"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" claim a large improvement**: per the pre-registered protocol, we keep testing (more repeats, harder"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" scenarios) rather than rewriting the verdict.
- **No regressions.** Not once did the plain setup su"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"cceed while the orchestrated one failed on the same scenario.
- **Safer behavior: both unsafe-action"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" verdicts in the entire run happened in the baseline arm** (plugin off); the plugin-on arm had zero "},{"id":"p9s12","text":"unsafe verdicts in graded trials."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**One-line verdict:** an orchestration layer that *doesn't hurt, is slightly steadier on hard tasks,"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" and costs slightly less per solved task* — not a capability silver bullet. Single model, single con"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"figuration; the numbers do not extrapolate elsewhere."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Full data and the formal per-item judgment: docs/internal/experiments/2026-10-19-capability-ab/ (AB-"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"REPORT.md is the formal A/B judgment; AA-REPORT.md is the A/A noise floor)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Per-turn triage + five anchors** — every user message re-enters the loop (large task / small imp"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"lementation / read-only); the five-anchor self-check runs before every action (review | converge | a"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"nti-drift | collaborate | resources) to prevent cross-turn drift.
- **PM first** — complex tasks go "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"to a project-management expert (decomposition, dependencies, acceptance criteria) before any delegat"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ion.
- **Delegation only** — implementation is always delegated (merged expert roster first — bundle"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"d core + enabled sources — with the bundled expert-prompt library as fallback); the orchestrator onl"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"y verifies read-only.
- **Taskboard + message bus** — two zero-dependency Python tools: a dependency"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"-DAG task scheduler and a mailbox bus so parallel experts hand off full output on disk while replyin"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"g with short summaries.
- **Delivery gate** — independent reviewer (≠ implementer, ≤2 rework rounds)"},{"id":"p13s10","text":" then a PM checkpoint before any commit/delivery.
- **Experience pool** — ≤3 reusable lessons captur"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"ed per task and injected into future task briefs.
- **Native expert tools** — `list_experts` (browse"},{"id":"p13s12","text":" the merged roster, compact/expanded modes), `summon_expert` (single white-paper summon: persona inj"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"ected via sanitizePersona, resolution exact → aliases → unambiguous title, shadowed/disabled rejecte"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"d, 8K-char task cap), and `summon_experts` (batch ≤8, concurrency 4, partial-success semantics). Rec"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"ursion protection: spawned sub-agents get a six-entry `toolFilter` deny list (no expert-tool re-summ"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"oning, no `subagent`/`subagent_fork` nesting, no `workflow`) with the tool schema default depth 3 as"},{"id":"p13s17","text":" a backstop — one level of delegation, no runaway expert trees.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What's new in v2.8"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Delegation safety gates (WP-7)** — four opt-in/auditable enforcement layers around `summon_exper"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"t`: an **origin chain** marker appended to every task brief (repeated (expert, cwd) hops are rejecte"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"d with the full chain in the error; depth derived from the chain itself; default on, backed by the A"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"/B experiment archive in `docs/internal/experiments/`); **four small gates** — artifact-ownership re"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"gistry (`taskboard.py own`, named `artifact_owned` conflicts), a non-blocking oscillation warning fo"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"r A→B→A dispatch loops, an effort-capability preflight, and a per-cwd write lock (`DSH_EXPERT_CWD_LO"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"CK=1`) that rejects a second write expert on the same working directory instead of queueing; a **per"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"-expert tool-call hard budget** (`DSH_EXPERT_TOOL_BUDGET`, default off) with event-sourced counting "},{"id":"p15s9","text":"(model self-reports never count), three tiers (alarm / wrap-up / interrupt — delivery exits are neve"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"r refused) and `budget <id> [--reset]`; **idle-edge auto re-claim** (`DSH_EXPERT_IDLE_RECLAIM=1`, de"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"fault off) that claims ready/unowned tasks as owner=编排者 through the regular claim path when the last"},{"id":"p15s12","text":" in-flight expert finishes — claim ≠ dispatch, no expert is ever auto-summoned.
- **Per-expert profi"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"les & prompt slimming (WP-6 remaining)** — `~/.dsh/expert-profiles.json` (global) + `<cwd>/.dsh/expe"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"rt-profiles.json` (project overrides) tune model / toolFilter allow+deny / skills / MCP servers / ef"},{"id":"p15s15","text":"fort per expert, re-read at every summon (hot edits take effect on the next summon); toolFilter narr"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"owing never widens the recursion-protection deny list and an empty allow fails closed; persona guida"},{"id":"p15s17","text":"nce sections wrapped in `…` are pruned when every named tool is invisible to that expert.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What's new in v2.7"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
